value.rationale: A sharp numerical-free sampled-data stability guarantee with a genuine nonmonotone discount interval gives a motivated design boundary for short-horizon feedback, and isolates failure arising from within-hold discount rather than integration error. It is nontrivial uniqueness and exact bifurcation classification, not a routine special parameter substitution; applicability is explicitly restricted to the one-step scalar controller.
